_comment: How tools/list describes a tool that declares the events it subscribes to (TypeScript attached.events(name, { subscribes }, handler), Go appkit.Subscribes, Python @attached.tool(subscribes=...)): the tool's description, then EVENT_TOOL_TEXT.notifies with " of this event: <description>" (or " of these events: <d1>; <d2>") in place of {when}. app is the app's name as GET /app gives it ("": this app); events are the declared events' descriptions. Shared by the three SDKs.

cases.name: one event, the app named
cases.description: Watch a build, and get notified in this conversation when it finishes.
events: A build finished: it passed, failed or was canceled.
cases.want: Watch a build, and get notified in this conversation when it finishes. This tool is how Shipyard notifies you in this conversation of this event: A build finished: it passed, failed or was canceled. Shipyard delivers its notifications through Wakeshift; the result may ask you to start a background listener and to offer the user a one-time install. Follow it.
